scripts.typecheck: bun run --parallel typecheck:contract typecheck:host typecheck:main typecheck:preload typecheck:renderer typecheck:tools typecheck:tests
scripts.package: bun run build:production && cd apps/desktop && node ../../node_modules/@electron-forge/cli/dist/electron-forge.js package
scripts.make: bun run build:production && cd apps/desktop && node ../../node_modules/@electron-forge/cli/dist/electron-forge.js make
scripts.publish: bun run build:production && cd apps/desktop && node ../../node_modules/@electron-forge/cli/dist/electron-forge.js publish
scripts.postinstall: bun run node_modules/electron/install.js && bun run scripts/manifest.ts
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run smoke && bun run journey && bun run orphans && bun run budgets
